sources.snippet: We address this question with DTM-Codec, a 127M-parameter neural speech codec trained on LibriSpeech-960 alone [panayotov2015librispeech] —modest in both model size and data compared with recent systems that leverage large-scale multi-domain corpora and semantic teacher models [xin2024bigcodec, ye2025llasa, huang2024flexicodec].

sources.snippet: 📌 核心摘要 本文提出了DTM-Codec，一个通过动态令牌掩码（DTM）实现可变帧率（VFR）的神经语音编解码器，旨在解决先前VFR工作在评估中未严格纳入位置信息比特开销的问题。
